Iincoko zakho, iifoto zabathandekayo bakho, ngubani okwi-intanethi, ngubani osele efundile. Yonke into osele uyazi, ngaphandle kokuba apha wonke umntu ukubhalela ngolwimi lwakhe ze wena ufunde ngolwakho.
Wena: Iiholide ezimnandi kulo lonke usapho lwakho 🎉
Yivule uze ucofe “Faka i-app”: iza kuhlala kwisikrini sakho sasekhaya nophawu lwayo, njenge-app eqhelekileyo. Igama lakho, ulwimi lwakho, ilungile.
Thumela ikhonkco lakho nge-SMS okanye ngomyalezo. Uza kukufumana ngokucofa kanye.
Bhala okanye ufowune ngolwimi lwakho. Omnye ukufunda aze akuve ngolwakhe.
Iakhawunti enye, uthungelwano olunye, ubulula obufanayo kuyo yonke indawo.
Imiyalezo, imiyalezo yelizwi neefowuni nabantu onxibelelana nabo. Wonke umntu ubhala aze athethe ngolwimi lwakhe, omnye amkele ngolwakhe.
Ubuso ngobuso nomntu ongaluthethiyo ulwimi lwakho: ifowuni iphakathi kwenu, ngamnye nemakrofoni yakhe.
Izifundo ezimfutshane nemithambo yokuthetha ulwimi olutsha ngokwakho.
Ngaphezu kakhulu kwe-app: i-{OW} ifuna ukuba liziko lotshintshiselwano lwehlabathi. Ukuthetha, ukufunda, ukuthenga, ukuthengisa, ukusebenza, ukudibana: wonke umntu ngolwimi lwakhe.
Namhlanje, uguqulelo lusebenza ngaphakathi kwe-{OW}. Ukuyidibanisa nezinye iindlela zonxibelelwano yindlela esiyilandelayo.

Iprofayili nefoto yakho zibonwa ngabantu onxibelelana nabo kuphela.
Ivuleka kwisikhangeli ize ifakwe efowunini ngentshukumo enye.
Lwenziwe eFransi ngumseki walo, ngaphandle kwentengiso.
Injongo yethu: iziko lotshintshiselwano lwehlabathi, ukuze wonke umntu, nokuba ukuphi na, akwazi ukuthetha, ukufunda nokurhweba nehlabathi lonke.
Iifowuni zevidiyo eziguqulelweyo, ezinemibhalo engezantsi ngolwimi lwakho.
Thengisa, thenga, ngenisa iimpahla, thumela imali kwaye ulandele imakethi yezabelo kunye nehlabathi lonke, ngamnye ngolwimi lwakhe.
Yiba ngomnye wabo baqalayo. Mema umntu osondeleyo, kwaye kunye masenze ihlabathi lithethe.
Cela okanye unikeze uncedo, simahla, kubantu behlabathi lonke.
Thatha umfanekiso weleta okanye weyeza elibhaliweyo: liyifunde ngolwimi lwakho.
Iinombolo zongxamiseko zelizwe ngalinye kunye nezivakalisi ezisindisa ubomi, ziguqulelwe.
Umakhulu ekugqibeleni uthetha nomzukulwana wakhe ohlala kwelinye icala lehlabathi. Elowo ngolwimi lwakhe.
Ulahlekile ekupheleni kwehlabathi, uyathetha, kwaye umntu uyakuphendula.
Ingcali yobugcisa yasetyhini yaseMadagascar ithengisa imisebenzi yayo kwihlabathi lonke.
Abantu obathandayo, umthengisi emarikeni, ugqirha phesheya: yivule, kwaye wonke umntu uyakuqonda.
